# Schilo's

> German Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Split pea soup, Reuben, homemade root beer and breakfast. San Antonio's oldest restaurant.

- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Breakfast; German plates; Soup, sandwiches and root beer
